stem: Use a calculator (in degree mode) to find the {=W[i]} of ${=A[j]}^\circ$. Round the result to four decimal places.
solution: Make sure the calculator is in degree mode.
Press the {=W[i]} key, then enter {=A[j]}, then press =.
Rounded to four decimal places, the {=W[i]} of ${=A[j]}^\circ$ is {=T[i][j]}.
notes: Values precomputed (standard 4 d.p. table values) for angles 20,25,35,40,50,55,65,70.
